name: SellToken miner spot-priced reward inflation
summary: The miner converts accrued BNB-denominated rewards into token amounts using PancakeSwap router spot quotes. Attackers depressed the thin token/USDT quote pools, claimed inflated rewards through matured mining positions, then sold the rewards into deeper token/WBNB pools.

loss.notes: Conservative realised quote-asset lower bound across seven confirmed manipulation transactions. Each WBNB component is net depletion across the affected trading pools, less all setup BNB for that actor group once (0.0036, 0.010 and 0.030 BNB). USDT is the signed campaign sum, including the second transaction's 0.661459298882182206 USDT input. Transaction-level trading inputs and repaid financing principal cancel in pool deltas; token donations to the miner are not counted again. Full deposit deductions conservatively also remove any returned LP value. Gas and later recoveries are not deducted; this is not a gross valuation of stolen reward tokens. Retained rewards remain unvalued, including 840.255603445821573055 HNC, 69.315443569355039167 TRDT, 57.15613671856139587 SHORT and 15.13895279708072133 HNC. Further unrecognized campaigns may increase loss.

limitations: The incident anchor remains provisional pending broader direct-claim screening; its loss is a lower bound.

sources.note: Reviewed verified miner source at https://bscscan.com/address/0x84be9475051a08ee5364fba44de7fe83a5ecc4f1#code, creation trace and historical runtimes. The deployment transaction creates factory 0x83c78f34c78ed8983f731ac9a18b3ff187974b02, which CREATEs the miner; the EOA is not its immediate creator. Code is absent at block 26714213 and identical at 26714214, 29005754 and 29435876. This direct runtime has no upgrade, delegatecall or selfdestruct route. Constructor-fixed router, WBNB and USDT addresses have no setters; setAdmin does not affect reward pricing. User mining deposits establish exposure rather than replace the quote logic. sendMiner calls getbnb, which uses router.getAmountsOut for the current WBNB/USDT/token or WBNB/token route, then transfers that token quote times elapsed days. The balanceOf(msg.sender)>=reward condition does not make the quote manipulation-resistant. The anchor claims 3079029.755011754173992263 SELLC for each of four helpers after altering the secondary pool. This is separate from the May SELLC transaction 0x59ed06fd0d44aec351bed54f57eccec65874da5a25a0aa71e348611710ec05f3, whose trace executes another contract's sell function and never this miner.

Etherscan account queries from block 0 through 999999999 return 5006 direct miner transactions and 3490 native internal rows; paginated token history returns 14058 rows before deduplication. Tracing all 33 token-movement transactions absent from direct history finds seven sendMiner manipulation transactions and 26 deposit transactions. This catches contract callers, not all possible earlier direct-EOA manipulation. There are 4007 successful direct sendMiner transactions. A token-quantity outlier screen followed by traces of 16 calls explains large sampled direct payouts through ordinary quote sizes and accumulated days/positions: four TRDT payouts at blocks 28996471–28996814 are 15-day rewards on 5 BNB positions, and large SELLC payouts at blocks 28393482–28393520 aggregate multiple positions. This sample does not establish exhaustive earliest exploitation or campaign closure; pre-claim pool trading for other direct payouts remains to be screened.

Reproduce net quote-asset amounts from each source-6 receipt by summing outgoing minus incoming Transfer amounts across the affected pairs: 0x358efc593134f99833c66894ccecd41f550051b6, 0x9523b023e1d2c490c65d26fad3691b024d0305d7, 0xe33292baf1ec6e42937276c193c62649b01695f6, 0xd52ab3436ea694b8d89ec32faf3ad66b3cede164, 0x8682e5cd3102e846e2c3c5b0eecdcc15baa59a63, 0x2ecc42572d5150af3acdf417dcee82e2a45e438b, 0x023a88a86ec6450eb697c1672021a8c083ca2b93, 0xbb61d6d4f9b69dc14aa2df0749df9f8352654e8b and WBNB/USDT pair 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae. Including both manipulated and reference pools cancels intermediate swaps. In source-6 order, pre-setup-deduction WBNB amounts are 446.64258375797062934, 66.93800459331513202, 34.073401151142206958, 0.553551766268723888, 4.399523058878786265, 0.95409454833267796, 0.247328945853234577; USDT amounts are 0, -0.661459298882182206, 0, 0, 0.101009547285014258, 1.248813452400033944, 0.243219196660670026. WBNB is valued using the reference pair's getReserves (0x0902f1ac) at each exploit block minus one: token0 is USDT, token1 WBNB, both 18 decimals, and USD per WBNB is reserve0/reserve1 at USDT par. Corresponding prices are 235.8102758176171506012519794, 236.2155703667535621882130739, 231.0452906764288967501847415, 231.1226030553287507623901102, 249.6349828276087390172176339, 237.5476056309552489849117217, 237.5487659753075043598795185. Component quantities deduct full source-7 deposits once from the first leg of each actor group. Later 1.2, 1 and 3 BNB call values are trading inputs already accounted for through pool inflows. Reward-token transfers and native token-fee payouts are not added separately. The later helpers also donate reward tokens before claiming; receipt net amounts and external proceeds avoid valuing those deposits as stolen rewards.

sources.provider: PancakeSwap V2 WBNB/USDT historical reserves via BSC archive RPC

limitations: The earliest known helper manipulation is anchored, but exhaustive earlier direct-claim and prior-pool-trade screening remains incomplete.
Realised proceeds establish a lower bound; retained reward tokens and potentially unrecognized campaigns prevent a comparable full-loss valuation.
